rows.jyutping: m4 hai6 zi6 min2 ji3 si1 ge3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when explaining that language should not be understood literally.

example.english: When I say “I’m freezing cold,” it’s figurative, not that I’m really turning to ice.
example.traditional: 我講「凍到結冰」只係唔係字面意思嘅講法，唔係真係結冰。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 dung3 dou3 git3 bing1 zi2 hai6 m4 hai6 zi6 min2 ji3 si1 ge3 gong2 faat3 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 git3 bing1

rows.note: Use this for language presented as a metaphor or other figure of speech, especially when contrasting it with literal wording.

example.english: When they say their heart is broken, that is figurative, not that it has literally split open.
example.traditional: 佢話自己個心碎咗，呢句係比喻嘅，唔係真係裂開。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 go3 sam1 seoi3 zo2 nei1 geoi3 hai6 bei2 jyu6 ge3 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 lit6 hoi1
